app.title: Angular Evolution Lab
app.tagline: Live demos of Angular's evolution from v16 to v22

layout.footer: Built with Angular 22 · zoneless · signals · Angular Aria

v16.title: Signals arrive
v16.intro: Angular 16 introduced signals as a reactive primitive, plus DestroyRef, required inputs and router input binding. Each card below is live: use it, then compare the code before and now.

cart.title: signal · computed · effect
cart.description: Accessory cart: quantities are a signal, totals are computed, and an effect reacts to every change.

search.title: toSignal + debounceTime + switchMap
search.description: Type to search vehicles. RxJS debounces and cancels stale requests; the result is read as a signal.
search.label: Search brand or model
search.hint: Start typing — requests wait 300 ms after your last keystroke.

destroy.title: DestroyRef · takeUntilDestroyed
destroy.description: A live telemetry feed subscribes to an interval. Unmount it and the subscription is cleaned up automatically.
destroy.unmounted: Telemetry unmounted — no subscription left behind.

required.title: Required inputs with transform
required.description: The price tag requires an amount and power; transforms turn HTML attribute strings into numbers and booleans.
required.dynamic: Bound to controls (strings in, numbers out):

binding.title: withComponentInputBinding
binding.description: The ?vehicle= query parameter is bound straight into a component input by the router. Click a link and watch the URL.
binding.hint: Pick a vehicle above — the last link triggers a 404 Problem Details.

v17.title: Control flow & defer
v17.intro: Angular 17 brought built-in control flow (@if, @for, @switch), deferrable views and — in 17.1/17.2 — signal inputs, model() and signal queries.

for.title: @for with track and @empty
for.description: {{rows}} stock units. Switch the tracking strategy, then refresh or shuffle and watch how many table rows the browser had to create.
for.filter: Filter by model, dealer or VIN

defer.title: @defer (on viewport)
defer.description: The chart below lives in its own lazy chunk. It is only downloaded when you scroll it into view.
defer.placeholder: @placeholder — the chart chunk has not been requested yet.

io.title: input() · model() · output()
io.description: Each rating is a child component: label is a required input, the value is a two-way model() and every pick emits an output().
io.reset: Set both to 1 from the parent

queries.title: viewChild · viewChildren (signal queries)
queries.description: Pre-delivery checklist. The parent queries its children as signals, so the progress is a plain computed.

vt.title: withViewTransitions
vt.description: Switching the layout is a router navigation (?layout=). The browser animates every car to its new position with the View Transitions API.

v18.title: Zoneless preview
v18.intro: Angular 18 shipped experimental zoneless change detection, @let (18.1), ng-content fallbacks, unified form events and functional redirects. This app itself runs without zone.js.

zoneless.title: Zoneless change detection
zoneless.description: No zone.js here. Each button changes a value inside setTimeout. Only the signal tells Angular to re-render; the plain field stays stale until something else schedules a check.
zoneless.explain: With zone.js, both timers would trigger a check of the whole app. Zoneless, the click itself schedules one check (counter +1), but the plain-field timer does not — press markForCheck() to reveal its real value.

let.title: @let — template variables
let.description: Leasing calculator: net amount, monthly rate and total are declared once with @let and reused in the template.

fallback.title: ng-content fallback
fallback.description: Both cards are the same component. The first projects nothing into its title slot, so the fallback content renders.
fallback.defaultBody: No [card-title] projected — the <h2> inside <ng-content> is used.
fallback.customBody: A [card-title] element was projected, so the fallback is skipped.

events.title: control.events — unified form events
events.description: Every change in this Reactive Form arrives through one stream: value, status, touched, pristine, submit and reset.
events.vinHint: 17 characters, no I, O or Q

redirect.title: redirectTo as a function
redirect.description: Old deep links like /v18/legacy/golf-7 are redirected by a function that keeps the model as a query param.
redirect.result: Redirected from legacy link "{{model}}" by a functional redirectTo.
redirect.hint: Click a legacy link to see the redirect.

v19.title: linkedSignal & resource
v19.intro: Angular 19 added linkedSignal for writable derived state and the resource APIs for async data as signals. @let became stable.

linked.title: linkedSignal — country → city
linked.description: The city is derived from the country but stays writable: pick any city, then switch country and it resets to the first city of the new list.

resource.title: resource() — dealers in the selected city
resource.description: A Promise-based loader with fetch() and an AbortSignal. Change the city quickly: the previous request is aborted, and the old list stays visible (dimmed) while reloading.

rx.title: rxResource() — vehicles by fuel type
rx.description: The same idea with an Observable stream through HttpClient, so all four interceptors (base URL, loading bar, Problem Details, mock backend) apply.
rx.failed: The vehicle service returned 503 Service unavailable.
